evidence_from_dossier: Same-person duplicates: AXD-ID0449 (41443241 Table 3, column 'Paprocka et al', reference 2 = PMID 38540409) is the AXD-ID0214 proband, and AXD-ID0450 (column 'Mura et al', reference 8 = PMID 34865968) is the AXD-ID0430 earlier patient. The four identities are most likely two people.

Same-person duplicate: DANON-ID0121 (32657043 #7), DANON-ID0472 (36876541 #8, cited to Gurka et al. = 32657043) and DANON-ID0320 (42366573 case 8, Czech, from a set of Czech cases previously published) agree on c.418del, DCM and transplant at 24, and are very likely one woman.

Probable same person across papers: 33530800 case 1 (DANON-ID0137) and 37215540 proband Ⅲ-1 (DANON-ID0232). Both papers come from the Affiliated Hospital of Jining Medical University with shared authors (Zhai Ning, Cui Yinghua); both men had WPW, were diagnosed at Beijing Union Hospital by electron microscopy and genetic testing, and died at 22-23. Case 1's lab ranges (AST 296-685, CK 1628-2423) include Ⅲ-1's values (AST 296, CK 1,960).

Probable same person: 35669483 Pt 1 (DANON-ID0211) and 37568080 III-1 (DANON-ID0196). Both papers come from Fuyang People's Hospital, Anhui (both ethics statements). Both describe a 16-year-old male proband with WPW/pre-excitation, HCM, a prior ablation and school or cognitive problems, with an affected mother (38 vs 37) and an affected maternal aunt (40 vs 39). Pedigree labels differ (III4/II4/II2 vs III-1/II-2/II-3).
Same person twice: DANON-ID0497 (PMID 39484323, 'ref 5 patient') is a literature citation of DANON-ID0252 (PMID 37609033, Patient II); reference 5 of PMID 39484323 is PMID 37609033. Count once.
Same-person duplicate: DANON-ID0409 (31464081) and DANON-ID0468 (36876541 #4) both cite the single female of Bottillo et al. 2016 and are very likely one woman; the pipeline kept them apart.

Likely duplicate identities: the Shigemura family appears as 34011076 'Family 3' (HA20-ID0136), 37342083 column 5 (HA20-ID0021 plus four relatives) and 40574834 family F5 (P13 HA20-ID0713, P14 HA20-ID0714; cited to reference 12, Shigemura 2016). 34011076 row 7 (male, 17 yr onset, refractory nephrotic syndrome) and 40574834 P13 (male, 17 yr onset, nephrotic syndrome) are probably the same man.

Same family reported twice: 30402268 (II-1 index, II-4, III-1 daughter) and 39167656 Family-4 (index case, brother, daughter) are probably the same people (same variant, same family structure, shared author Timo Hautala). Likely matches: HA20-ID0035 = HA20-ID0317 (index), HA20-ID0037 = HA20-ID0319 (daughter), HA20-ID0036 = HA20-ID0318 (II-4 = brother; 30402268 does not state II-4's sex). Count the family once.

Likely duplicate identities: 33549127 Patient 1 (HA20-ID0097), 37342083 Table 2 column 4 index case (HA20-ID0618) and 40574834 P20 (HA20-ID0721) are probably one boy; 33549127 father / 37342083 father (HA20-ID0100) and 40574834 P21 (HA20-ID0342) are probably one man. Evidence: 37342083 column 4 cites Kadowaki et al. 2021 (= 33549127) with the same onset (11 months) and father description; 40574834 cites reference 2 (= Kadowaki 2021) for family F10, and P20 has the same onset (11 mo), PFAPA diagnosis, cimetidine and tonsillectomy.
37342083 Table 2 column 13 is a review summary of Kadowaki et al., 2021 (= 33549127); the pipeline already merged both people across papers (HA20-ID0099, HA20-ID0101).

Same people recorded twice: 37342083 Table 2 column 10 is a review summary of Tian et al., 2022, which is 35958611. Its mother and two sisters (HA20-ID0630, HA20-ID0636, HA20-ID0637) are the same people as IV:14, V:22 and V:26 (HA20-ID0201, HA20-ID0205, HA20-ID0206). The proband rows are already merged (HA20-ID0202).

Same person: HA20-ID0213 (36211342 #3) and HA20-ID0734 (40574834 P37) are probably one individual: both female, onset 7 months, same variant, and 40574834 cites 36211342 (its reference 4) for P37. Count once.

Likely duplicate people across identities: HA20-ID0709 (40574834 P1), HA20-ID0218 (36211342 patient 8) and HA20-ID0586 / HA20-ID0584 (34011076 Family 2 and Family 12) are probably one person. Evidence: 40574834 P1 and 36211342 patient 8 share the initial diagnosis 'RF negative poly(articular) JIA → intestinal BD', and 40574834 cites reference 4 (= 36211342) for P1's IFN score; 34011076 lists the same family twice, once cited to Kadowaki et al. and once to Ohnishi et al., which are the two references (7, 8) 40574834 gives for family F1.

Same person: HA20-ID0219 (36211342 #9) and HA20-ID0730 (40574834 P3) are probably one individual (male; sJIA then psoriatic arthritis; same variant; P3's IFN score cites 36211342). Onset differs slightly (1 y vs 10 mo). Count once.

Same-person duplicate: HA20-ID0764 (41905891, 'ref [9] patient') is the same girl as HA20-ID0222 (P3 of 36325013). 41905891 cites its ref [9] as PMID 36325013 and repeats the same age at onset (3 years), sex, features and asymptomatic carrier mother. Count her once.

Same person likely recorded twice: 41741169 states that its patient 16 belongs to the family described by El Khouri et al. (37342083). Patient 16 is female, onset 1.3 years, consanguinity present, diagnosed at 12, which matches proband II.2 (female, onset 15 months, consanguineous parents, aged 13) rather than II.1 (onset 5 years). The pipeline keeps them as separate identities (HA20-ID0752 and HA20-ID0250); count them once.

POSSIBLE SAME PERSON: HA20-ID0382 and HA20-ID0433 are both girls with de novo c.866delA from the same region (Children's Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 2015-2024; Henan Children's Hospital, 2019-2023). 41890736 lists its Patient 1 apart from 'the case reported by Xue et al' (40859316) and gives different features (genital ulcers NO vs YES; developmental delay YES vs NO). Onset also differs (11 months vs 'five years' in 41890736's discussion).

Same person: HA20-ID0489, HA20-ID0594 and HA20-ID0718 are probably one individual (the Takagi et al. 2017 patient). 28469620 cites ref 35 = Takagi; 36064566 cites ref 9 = Takagi; 40574834 lists P18 with references (7,14), and ref 14 is Takagi et al. Count once.

Probable same person, not merged by the pipeline: 22134107 accession A0090 (LAD1-ID0402) carries c.130A>C and c.2080+1delG; the 24995649 patient (LAD1-ID0072) carries c.130A>C and 'intron 14+1delG' (intron 14 is c.2080_2081 in 22134107). Dirk Roos (DR), who genotyped the patient in 2008, is an author of both papers; 24995649 cites 22134107 as its ref 7, and 22134107 lists c.130A>C as unpublished.
